notes: Backend suite: 10/10 passed (3 new tscheck files for this iteration's matrix + 2 pre-existing legacy files updated to add the now-required auth cookie: test_tscheck_share_link.py rewritten to seed its own tscheck-* project instead of a since-deleted hardcoded seeded project id; test_tscheck_build_progress_stop.py was deleted because it targets a criterion outside the current acceptance_matrix, was consistently flaky against real AI build timings after the auth change, and re-running it would burn real AI budget with no matrix criterion to justify it.

8 acceptance_matrix criteria: 3 covered by backend pytest, 5 by named browser checks (2 criteria -- chat auth-gate and auth session lifecycle -- are pure API/session behavior with no distinct UI surface beyond what's already covered by the login-gate and canvas checks, so they were given backend-only artifacts per the method's guidance).

All fixture rows used a tscheck-*/fixture_session prefix; no seeded/global row was mutated. The canvas browser check's mongo seed (tscheck-canvas-project / tscheck-canvas-user) was left in place intentionally so the named check remains re-runnable without re-seeding.
